documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our regional logistics team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is in the 'nurture' stage with a score of 50 and an intent of 50. The customer has provided consent and is currently exploring options without a specific project owner identified. The account is not blocked and is being managed by cedar-east.

claims.quote: Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your regional logistics team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we address your needs effectively, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify your requirements and explore how Cedar Systems can support your workflow coordination and account reporting needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will be happy to accommodate.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific workflow coordination needs does your logistics team have?
Are there any current challenges with your account reporting processes?
uncertainties: The lack of a specific project owner may delay decision-making.
The customer has not yet identified specific requirements, which may impact the discovery meeting's effectiveness.
